items.title: 9.7 Motion of charged particles in a uniform electric field

source_refs.note: Topic 9.7 with Fig. 9.17 (PDF 205-206, printed 202-203). The missing factor 10¹² in v² is marked with a Book correction box.

blocks.text: Two oppositely charged parallel metal plates produce uniform electric field between them. The direction of electric field is from positive to negative plate. A positive charge +q placed in the field will move in the direction of electric field whereas a negative charge −q will move opposite to the electric field.
